what: scopeMatchesPath focused-mode depth rule (recall.ts, April 2026 fix): scope is EXCLUDED when `scopeDepth < parentDepth`. Previously was `scopeDepth < parentDepth - 1` which wrongly included grandparent scopes for file queries. Example: query `src/api/routes.ts` (parentDepth=2), scope `src/**` (depth=1) → old `1 < 1` false → INCLUDED (BUG); new `1 < 2` true → EXCLUDED (correct per memory #95). The `-1` offset previously allowed "one level above immediate parent" which conflicts with the design "only immediate parent + same level + deeper". Tests e2e-comparison.test.ts and cli.test.ts were updated to match — they were asserting old buggy behavior.
why: Specific bug + fix detail for anyone revisiting scope-matching semantics. Conflict between inline comment (allowed grandparent) and design memory #95 (forbade grandparent) is now resolved in favor of the design.
